tools.name: airscale_find_companies
tools.description: Search companies by firmographic, location, event, intent, technology, and website keyword filters. Costs 0.1 credits per returned company. Use airscale_find_companies_filter_values to discover accepted values.

country.description: Country names or ISO codes, e.g. ["France", "US"]

region.description: Region values from filter-values, e.g. ["California|US"] or ["us-ca"]

city.description: City|Region|Country values from filter-values, e.g. ["San Francisco|California|US"]

age.description: Company age ranges in years, e.g. ["3-6"]

keywords.description: Free-text keywords found on the company website

filters.description: At least one real filter is required by the API

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous response; used instead of page

tools.name: airscale_find_companies_filter_values
tools.description: Discover accepted values for find-companies filters (city, region, industry, topics, techStack). Free, no credits charged.

country.description: Country name or ISO code to narrow location results

region.description: Region code or value to narrow city results, e.g. "us-ca"

tools.name: airscale_airsearch
tools.description: AI web research agent: ask a natural-language question and optionally specify structured fields to extract. Costs 2 credits per call.

schema.description: Fields to extract: keys are output names, values are types (string, url, email, number, int, float, boolean, date, phone) or free-text descriptions. If omitted, the agent infers fields

tools.name: airscale_leads_finder
tools.description: Search people with Leads Finder filters (job, company, location, seniority, skills, company size, funding, and more). Zero-based page pagination. Costs 0.1 credits per returned lead.

company.description: Company names, domains, or LinkedIn company URLs

filters.description: At least one filter other than searchMode

tools.name: airscale_leads_finder_preview
tools.description: Leads Finder preview alias: same filters, results, and cost as airscale_leads_finder (0.1 credits per returned lead). It is not a free count.

company.description: Company names, domains, or LinkedIn company URLs

filters.description: At least one filter other than searchMode

spend.summary: 0.1 credits per returned lead; not a free count

tools.name: airscale_find_email
tools.description: Find a contact's professional email. Provide either a LinkedIn profile URL, or first/last name plus a company domain or name.

linkedin_profile_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the contact

tools.name: airscale_find_email_bulk
tools.description: Find professional emails for multiple contacts. Returns immediately; results are delivered to webhook_url, one payload per input.

webhook_url.description: Results are POSTed here, one payload per input

custom_id.description: Echoed back in the webhook payload

tools.name: airscale_find_mobile_phone
tools.description: Find a contact's mobile phone number from their LinkedIn profile URL.

linkedin_profile_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the contact

tools.name: airscale_find_personal_email
tools.description: Find a contact's personal email from their LinkedIn profile URL.

linkedin_profile_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the contact

verification.description: Verify the email's deliverability before returning it

tools.name: airscale_find_people_by_url
tools.description: Find a person's LinkedIn profile URL from their name and company.

tools.name: airscale_extract_people_profile
tools.description: Extract a full LinkedIn person profile from its URL.

spend.summary: URL-selected pricing; person-profile successes cost 1 credit by default and workspace-specific pricing may differ

tools.name: airscale_extract_company_profile
tools.description: Extract a full LinkedIn company profile from its URL.

spend.summary: URL-selected pricing; company or school-profile successes cost 0.5 credits and workspace-specific pricing may differ

tools.name: airscale_reverse_email
tools.description: Resolve an email address to a LinkedIn profile. Returns the entire enriched profile, not only the URL.

email.description: Email address to resolve to a LinkedIn profile

tools.name: airscale_reverse_phone
tools.description: Resolve a phone number to a LinkedIn profile. Returns the entire enriched profile, not only the URL.

mobile_phone.description: Phone number with country code, e.g. +33610607076

tools.name: airscale_domain_to_linkedin
tools.description: Find a company's LinkedIn company URL from its domain. Costs 0.5 credits on success; no-result lookups are free. Allow up to 130 seconds.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same request so it is not charged twice

spend.summary: 0.5 credits on success; no-result lookups are free

tools.name: airscale_post_likers
tools.description: List and enrich people who liked a LinkedIn post, one page (up to 25) at a time. Reserves 1 credit per requested slot and refunds unused, not-found, and failed slots.

idempotency_key.description: A UUID. Reuse it when retrying the same request so it is not charged twice

spend.summary: 1 credit per enriched profile; unused, not-found, and failed slots are refunded

tools.name: airscale_post_commenters
tools.description: List and enrich people who commented on a LinkedIn post, one page (up to 25) at a time. Reserves 1 credit per requested slot and refunds unused, not-found, and failed slots.

idempotency_key.description: A UUID. Reuse it when retrying the same request so it is not charged twice

spend.summary: 1 credit per enriched profile; unused, not-found, and failed slots are refunded

tools.name: airscale_verify_email
tools.description: Verify whether an email address is deliverable. Costs 0.5 credits. Allow up to 135 seconds.

tools.name: airscale_check_whatsapp
tools.description: Check whether a phone number is on WhatsApp. Costs 1 credit for a definitive yes or no. A pending or unknown result returns an operation_id to look up with airscale_get_whatsapp_check.

idempotency_key.description: A UUID. Reuse it when retrying the same request so it is not charged twice

spend.summary: 1 credit for a definitive yes or no

tools.name: airscale_get_whatsapp_check
tools.description: Look up a previous WhatsApp check by its operation_id. Free; does not start a new check.

tools.name: airscale_check_dnc
tools.description: Check whether a US phone number is on the Do Not Call list. Costs 1 credit per completed check.

tools.name: airscale_meta_ads
tools.description: Look up a company's Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads from its domain. Costs 1 credit when ads are found; otherwise free.

domain.description: Company domain or website URL, e.g. airscale.io

spend.summary: 1 credit when ads are found; otherwise free

tools.description: Start an async paid export of Find Companies results to CSV or JSONL. Returns an export_id; poll airscale_get_export_status.

tools.name: airscale_create_contact_enrichment_batch
tools.description: Create a server-side batch for CSV/file/table contact inputs with more than 20 rows before starting a managed bulk work-email enrichment export.

tools.name: airscale_add_contacts_to_enrichment_batch
tools.description: Add CSV/file/table contacts to a managed enrichment batch in chunks of up to 250. Use this for more than 20 rows instead of repeated single-contact lookup tools.

contacts.description: Contacts to add. Send uploaded CSV rows in chunks of up to 250.
